This record contains the text of speeches delivered in English and of the translation of speeches 
delivered in other languages. The final text will be printed in the Official Records of the 
Security Council.  Corrections  should be submitted to the original languages only. They should 
be incorporated in a copy of the record and sent under the signature of a member of the 
delegation concerned to the Chief of the Verbatim Reporting Service, room AB -0928 
(verbatimrecords@un.org ). Corrected records will be reissued electronically on the Official  
Document System of the United Nations ( http://documents.un.org ).
